messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you doing this week? Anything new with your blood pressure or medications you want to flag?

Not great honestly. I'm almost out of my lisinopril and my doctor said I need a new prescription before the pharmacy will fill it again. Problem is the pharmacy is 40 miles from me and getting out there isn't easy.
Thanks for telling me — I'm noting that your lisinopril supply is nearly gone and a new script is required. Before I do anything else, have you been able to check your blood pressure recently?
Yeah checked this morning. Was 151 over 94. Tends to creep up when I'm late on doses.

Logging that reading. Running low on a blood pressure medication with a reading in that range is something the nursing team needs to weigh in on — I'm escalating this to them now. Heads up that the median response time is currently 31 hours, so expect a message or call within that window. They'll be able to work through the prescription situation with you.
Okay. Any chance you can help line up a ride to the pharmacy once the script goes through? That drive is rough for me.

I wish I could help with that. Transportation isn't something I'm set up to arrange yet — that's outside what I can do right now. Worth bringing it up directly with the nurse when they reach out; they may know of local options. I'll schedule your next check-in for seven days out.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
